research.camera_coordinate_basis: Apple drawing explicitly covers SE 2nd and 3rd generation: rear lens/mic/flash x=10.44/18.13/22.84 mm, y=10.24 mm. Lens opening clears the 12.14 mm camera surround; tiny apertures and case lips use provisional clearance.

references.title: iPhone SE (2022) finished fine-hole case reference
references.notes: Covered pill-shaped camera surround with separate lens, mic and flash holes. Apple explicitly supplies one drawing for SE 2nd and 3rd generation; these intentionally share provisional case geometry but retain separate review decisions. The inspected finished-case photograph is labeled SE 2022; its shape is applied to SE 2020 using Apple dimensional compatibility. Rounded shoulder, mute switch and Lightning opening. Seller listing was out of stock when checked; exact printable blank, optical clearance and physical fit remain unverified.
